slides.title: "I keep pushing *good people* away."
slides.sub: It's one of the four places people start at Pathways.

slides.title: The come-here, go-away cycle
slides.body: Pull someone close. Push them away. Repeat.

slides.title: Misdirected anger
slides.body: Anger that lands somewhere other than where it started.

slides.title: Testing the people who love you
slides.body: Pushing to see if they'll stay.

slides.title: The Freedom Paradox
slides.body: Bill's course on this cycle. Stop chasing. Stop withdrawing. Start connecting. Chapter 1, The Invisible Wall, is a free preview.

slides.title: Patterns can be named. Then they can be changed.
